messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: multi-region latency spike detected — ~30% of requests to model-service in eu-west and us-east experiencing tail latencies > 2s. Trigger: p95 latency alarm. Pager dispatched to @Maya (oncall) and @Raj (SRE).
Maya (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing logs now. any customer-facing impact yet?
Jake (support): getting multiple customer tickets showing slow responses; one has a regression window around 2026-02-28T21:10Z. Notifying a couple of impacted accounts.
Maya (oncall): thanks Jake. Raj — can you check autoscale and any recent deploys?
Raj (SRE): looking. no recent infra deploys in the last 2h. noticed a batcher backlog on us-east nodes, KV cache misses spiking. suspect model variant cache churn.
Lin (eng-runtime): FYI we pushed a quantization profile rollback in eu-west ~20m ago for testing. could be related.
Maya (oncall): tentative mitigation: throttle background heavy requests and pin to last-known-good model variant. can we apply a routing rule?
Raj (SRE): applying temporary routing rule to shift non-critical traffic to spare pool and increase worker concurrency on affected pools. command run: ```sh
# scale up worker pool
redwoodctl scale pool model-service-us-east --replicas 6
redwoodctl route add --from default --to spare-pool --match "path:/batch" --weight 0.6
```
Lin (eng-runtime): rolling back the quant profile in eu-west now. watch KV hit-rate.
Maya (oncall): monitoring. p95 dropping from 2.4s -> 1.1s in us-east after scale. eu-west still a bit high at 1.6s but trending down.
Priya (product): any visible customer errors or data loss? need to prepare comms.
Jake (support): no errors returned, just slower responses. one client timed out at their side (they had 1s client timeout) — escalated to them.
Ava (security): any risk to data exfiltration or secrets?
Lin (eng-runtime): nothing indicates security issue. this looks performance/caching.
Maya (oncall): mitigation holding. will keep this thread for handoff and post-incident follow-up. planning RCA.
Maya (oncall): handoff to night oncall @Ben in 20m. Raj — can you capture mitigation steps and timeline into the incident doc? Lin — please add config diffs (quant profile rollback commands). Jake — assemble customer list impacted. Priya — I'll schedule a postmortem sync for tomorrow.
Raj (SRE): adding mitigation timeline to incident doc: - 21:07 alert fired; 21:09 pager to oncall; 21:12 identified batcher backlog; 21:18 scaled us-east; 21:25 routing rule applied; 21:42 eu-west quant rollback; 21:55 p95 stabilized.
Lin (eng-runtime): config diffs: ```diff
- quant_profile: experimental-v2
+ quant_profile: baseline-202601
```
Jake (support): impacted customers: acme-inc, fastchat, edu-labs. I'll DM each with incident brief and ETA.
Priya (product): Postmortem sync scheduled: 2026-03-01 16:00 UTC (30m). I'll invite SRE, runtime, support, security, and account reps.
Maya (oncall): action items (quick list): 1) Raj — formalize mitigation steps and add runbook updates (owner + due 2026-03-07). 2) Lin — revert unsafe auto-quant rollouts from staging path and add safety check (due 2026-03-05). 3) Priya/Jake — customer outreach summary + FAQ (due 2026-03-02). 4) Ava — confirm no security concerns + add monitoring for cache-anomaly (due 2026-03-04).
Ben (solutions): can we add an automated regression test for KV cache miss spikes triggered by quant profile changes? that would have caught this.
Lin (eng-runtime): agree. I'll prototype a canary that injects skewed quant profiles and watches KV hit rate. adding to backlog as engineering task (owner Lin, due 2026-04-01).
Maya (oncall): handing off: Ben is now oncall for the night. full log links: https://logs.redwood.ai/incident/1769999999 and incident doc: https://wiki.redwood.ai/incidents/1769999999.
Ben (solutions): ack. I'll monitor and keep the postmortem thread posted.
-- 10 hours later --
Ben (solutions): quick update: no recurrence during night window. collecting evidence for RCA draft.
Maya (oncall): thanks Ben. Raj/Lin — please add the exact command outputs to the doc and timestamped metrics.
Raj (SRE): added CPU, KV hit-rate, and request-queue metrics for timelines.
Lin (eng-runtime): added diff of the deployment pipeline that allowed the quant profile to reach eu-west test lanes.
Priya (product): drafting impact summary: "~30% of requests in two regions experienced elevated tail latency for ~45 minutes. No customer data loss; a handful of customers experienced client-side timeouts. Estimated severity: high-availability impact, potential SLA blip for paid customers."
Maya (oncall): starting RCA draft now. Outline I'll follow: Summary, Timeline, Impact, Contributing Factors, Root Causes, Mitigations, Action Items, Follow-up.
Maya (oncall): RCA draft link (private): https://docs.redwood.ai/rca/1769999999/draft — please comment inline.
Priya (product): I'll review impact & comms language.
Ava (security): I'll sign off on security section after quick scan.
Ben (solutions): recommend including proposed instrumentation to track quant rollout edge cases.
Raj (SRE): please tag me for peer review on Timeline and Mitigations.
-- 2 days later (RCA peer review) --
Priya (product): reviewed the draft. a few wording suggestions in Impact and Customer-facing summary. left inline comments.
Lin (eng-runtime): peer review done on Contributing Factors. I expanded on caching behavior and dependency on the KV eviction policy.
Ava (security): security sign-off: no concerns. suggested adding a one-time postmortem scan for secrets exposure as precaution.
Raj (SRE): suggested rewording: move a line from "Root Causes" to "Contributing Factors" about rollout gaps.
Maya (oncall): incorporated edits. final review requested from @Priya and @Raj.
Priya (product): LGTM on comms.
Raj (SRE): LGTM on technical sections.
Maya (oncall): RCA final draft marked ready for sign-off. signing owners: Maya (oncall), Raj (SRE), Priya (product). please acknowledge below to sign-off and we'll publish the postmortem and action tracker.
Raj (SRE): signing off. :white_check_mark:
Priya (product): signing off. :white_check_mark:
Maya (oncall): signing off. :white_check_mark:
Maya (oncall): publishing postmortem and creating follow-up sprint card with action items. tracker: https://tracker.redwood.ai/board/INC-1769999999
Jake (support): I'll send the customer follow-ups with the published postmortem link and FAQ.
Ben (solutions): thanks everyone. closing thread for active coordination — will keep it archived on the incident doc.
